top_story: US strikes on dozens of targets in Iran overnight on 30 July widened the regional confrontation and prompted Iranian retaliation against US partners, keeping diplomacy alive but under visible strain. That political deadlock sits atop an acute humanitarian collapse in Gaza, where Israel’s siege is blocking cancer treatment and leaving seriously ill patients to deteriorate without care. The immediate regional picture is one of simultaneous military escalation and fragile bargaining, with Gaza civilians bearing the cost while Israeli acceptance remains the key barrier to any shift from coercion to settlement.
